description: This file provides utility functions to resolve module paths from the current working directory, leveraging the 'resolve-from' module. It exports a main function for resolving modules and a 'silent' variant for silent resolution failure.

methods.name: module.exports
methods.description: Function to resolve a module path from the current working directory using 'resolve-from'.

methods.name: module.exports.silent
methods.description: Function to silently resolve a module path, returning undefined or error quietly if resolution fails.
